title: Tracker Needle Frame
description: The per-frame needle position the Jetson tracker broadcasts on its WebSocket after `hello`, wire protocol v2 (needle-simulator packages/needle-jetson/.../tracker/engine.py, _triangulate_and_broadcast(), with the two length fields from packages/needle-pipeline/.../pipeline/measure.py needle_length_fields()). Consumers: apps/desktop/src/types.ts (NeedleFrameWire) and lib/tracking/wire.ts, packages/needle-eval/.../schema.py (TrackEvent). Unlike `hello` and `status`, this frame has NO `type` field: the desktop client (ws_client.rs) treats every post-hello frame whose `type` is not `status` as a needle frame, so there is no discriminator to put in an envelope. All coordinates are tracker (trk) mm on the scene axes the producer's map_to_scene_mm() emits (needle-simulator packages/needle-pipeline/.../utils/coords.py): X depth into the phantom, Y up, Z right. Only v2 names are described here; the v1 spellings (confA/confB, surfaceX/Y/Z, lenSurfaceTip, lenEntryTip) are a consumer-side compatibility concern and are deliberately not part of this contract. Since 1.1.0 a frame may also carry `needles`, the numbered list of every needle the tracker is following (needle-simulator docs/decisions/0051-several-needles-numbered-list-plan-per-needle.md); the top-level fields stay the one needle the tracker sent before.
$comment: additionalProperties is true and MUST stay true: the tracker's stated rule is that additive optional fields do NOT bump protocol_version (see tracker/hello.json). `required` lists exactly what the producer sends on every frame; a frame that omits one of them is not a v2 frame (a v1 rig lacks conf_lo, skin_entry_*, surface_to_tip_mm and entry_to_tip_mm, and is rejected here on purpose).

tipX.description: Needle tip X, tracker mm (depth into the phantom).

entryX.description: Surface-snapped entry point X, tracker mm.

entryY.description: Surface-snapped entry point Y, tracker mm.

entryZ.description: Surface-snapped entry point Z, tracker mm.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time (Unix seconds, float) at which the engine built this frame.

source.description: `detected` = this frame had a fresh detection; `predicted` = detection was lost and the Kalman prediction is being broadcast. The producer never emits `lost`: that value exists only in the desktop's type and its e2e mock.

conf_lo.description: Detection confidence of the LO camera face (AprilTag ids 0-3). null when this frame had no detection on both faces (including every `predicted` frame).

conf_hi.description: Detection confidence of the HI camera face (AprilTag ids 4-7). null under the same conditions as conf_lo.

lastDetectionTimestamp.description: Wall-clock time (Unix seconds) of the last frame with a fresh detection. null if the engine has none since its last reset.

skin_entry_x.description: Skin-surface entry point X, tracker mm: where the needle line crosses the phantom's visible top face. null when the line does not cross it.

skin_entry_y.description: Skin-surface entry point Y, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

skin_entry_z.description: Skin-surface entry point Z, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

surface_to_tip_mm.description: Insertion length: skin-surface point to tip, mm. null when skin_entry_* is null.

entry_to_tip_mm.description: Length from the surface-snapped entry point to the tip, mm. Never null.

geometry_settling.description: OPTIONAL. Sent only by a tracker whose hello says world 'rig': true while it has seen the phantom or a camera move and its geometry has not followed yet, so the position may be off by up to that move (about 2 mm when the phantom is re-seated); false otherwise. Absent (a tracker in the phantom's frame): no such flag. Additive: protocol_version is not bumped.

needles.description: OPTIONAL. Every numbered needle the tracker is following this frame: at most the follower's slots (v1.0 handles 3; the format carries up to 4). A reader that understands `needles` uses only this array; a frame without it (the YOLO path, an older tracker) is one needle with no id, read from the top-level fields, which a tracker that sends `needles` still fills with the one needle it sent before. Candidates with no number are never listed. Additive: protocol_version is not bumped.

items.description: One numbered needle. Every field but `id` and `curve` means what the top-level field of the same name means, for this needle, in the same frame and axes.

id.description: The tracker's number for this needle. It stays the same while the tracker follows this needle and is never reused within one tracker run (hello `run`); across runs it means nothing.

entryX.description: Surface-snapped entry point X, tracker mm.

entryY.description: Surface-snapped entry point Y, tracker mm.

entryZ.description: Surface-snapped entry point Z, tracker mm.

skin_entry_x.description: Skin-surface entry point X, tracker mm. null when this needle's line does not cross the top face.

skin_entry_y.description: Skin-surface entry point Y, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

skin_entry_z.description: Skin-surface entry point Z, tracker mm. null together with skin_entry_x.

surface_to_tip_mm.description: Insertion length: skin-surface point to tip, mm. null when skin_entry_* is null.

entry_to_tip_mm.description: Length from the surface-snapped entry point to the tip, mm. Never null.

source.description: This needle's own filter: `detected` = a fresh detection this frame; `predicted` = its Kalman prediction.

conf_lo.description: As the top-level conf_lo, for this needle (the curve model puts its per-needle score in both conf_lo and conf_hi).

conf_hi.description: As the top-level conf_hi, for this needle.

lastDetectionTimestamp.description: Wall-clock time (Unix seconds) this needle was last detected. null if it has none.

curve.description: OPTIONAL. The needle's 3D points from the entry to the tip, as many as the model outputs (not the tracker page's 8). These are the model's raw points: tipX/entryX are filtered and surface-snapped, so the curve's ends need not equal them and can differ by a few mm.

items.description: One point [x, y, z], tracker mm, in the same frame and axes as tipX/tipY/tipZ.
